BEFORE  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SOUMITRA SAIKIA  ORDER 13.05.2025
Heard Mr. K.N. Choudhury, learned Senior Counsel assisted by Mr. N. Ahmed, learned counsel appearing for the petitioners.
Also heard Mr. D. Saikia, learned Advocate General, Assam assisted by Mr. B. Gogoi, learned Additional Advocate General, Assam appearing for the respondents.
The learned counsel for the petitioners has concluded his arguments.
The learned Advocate General has commenced his arguments; however, the same remained inconclusive.
Accordingly, the matters be listed on 15.05.2025 for further hearing.
Interim order passed will continue till the next date fixed.
